sampling_limits: Java execution sample shares exclude native GC/JIT and are not elapsed time shares.
Allocation sample weights estimate allocation churn, not retained heap.
run1.jfr is an overlapping snapshot, not independent samples.
Profile subwindows use command-start time inferred from existing GC wall/uptime logs; they include profiler setup/teardown around the requested 30-second sample.
CPU load means are fractions of host capacity, not CPU-seconds; do not interpret them as single-core fractions.
GC CPU event sums measure GC records, while stop-the-world pause totals come from GarbageCollection.sumOfPauses.
The run1-late profile is after runner JOIN: the main thread computes static guidance, not an active bidi worker.
Log-delimited worker window excludes the exact static-binding marker interval; reported engine437.728s includes about0.213s of post-binding setup/teardown outside the437.515s pre-binding window.
Resource CPU deltas use nearest 1-second observations with endpoint errors shown; they include native/JIT/GC CPU.
GCCPUTime records omit some concurrent G1 worker CPU; short stop-the-world pauses do not imply little GC CPU.
Young post-GC heap occupancy is not an exact retained-object census.
Static completion graph access is a scope family that includes runtime query callbacks; it is not a construction-cost label.
The enabled optimization statistics add atomic counter overhead;27.69% of near-limit leaf samples are in AtomicLongArray increment/VarHandle getAndAdd.
No heap dump, heap census, debugger, profiler attachment, analyzer run, or Gradle execution was performed for this investigation.
Batch publication widths, distinct complete writer premises and quotient input cardinalities were not recorded; no speedup multiplier follows from the profiles.

algorithmic_followup_candidates.candidate: Group joined writer results by owner and complete nonstatic premise.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.before: Each scalar (owner,I,C.f/U) repeats frozen candidate lookup, matching and transfer.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.after: Use the same frozen input lookup/matching result for a complete (owner,I), and process compatible packed static output deltas through the existing transfer/cover/cut path.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.example: set(p){C.f=p;C.g=p;C.h=p;} gives one input-selection problem for three output fields, rather than three identical candidate scans.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.must_preserve: Complete MethodKey/premise, raw FLOW mark exclusions, all output headers, ZERO guards, recursive writer fixed point and guidance sets. No static B row enters ordinary caller binding.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.needed_measurement: Scalar writer count versus distinct (owner,complete premise), candidate/match reuse and fresh guidance output counts. Cache/view memory must be measured; a full copied input list per premise can recreate memory growth.

algorithmic_followup_candidates.candidate: Use a guidance-only caller quotient during joined binding.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.before: InputKey contains full CallerRef including call node, stage and callerLayer, although the export uses only caller MethodKey, caller initial and output Pattern.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.after: Within the joined guide-only lane, share or union compatible actual inputs under caller MethodKey plus full caller initial, and retain the complete geometry/marks/E/mx/tail needed for matching/transfer.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.example: Two set(x) calls at different statements in one caller bind the same caller initial and actual image; both yield the same DEMAND guidance relation to C.f.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.must_preserve: No call suffix or alias is executed here. Prove forced-DEMAND/leaf-Pattern erasure makes unused layer/protection distinctions irrelevant before dropping them from the key. Do not reuse this quotient in live pubsub, which needs exact continuation positions.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.needed_measurement: Full CallerRefs versus distinct quotient keys, packed memberships and retained temporary bytes. Existing duplicateInputs=0 only shows current exact-key duplicates are absent.

algorithmic_followup_candidates.candidate: Make typed-terminal static guidance lookup demand-directed and reuse immutable reachability work.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.before: Each ZERO-original summary can start a fresh all-terminal-origin reverse BFS, even when most origins cannot intersect its raw output.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.after: First reject impossible origin families (a nonstatic or ZERO origin requires an applicable local W row), then select relevant endpoint/mark families before traversal and reuse equivalent query/adjacency work in the immutable run1-to2 completion, with the existing paired C5 predicate as the acceptance check.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.must_preserve: Mapped mark changes, field/tail compatibility, method-local versus reachable-owner scopes, local-first coverage and ZERO/Target typed endpoints. Do not weaken C5 or eagerly expand every static composition.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.needed_measurement: Queries per complete method/raw-output key, unique graph states, compositions collapsed to existing states, owner checks and cache memory.
